tickets.title: Prepare mortgage liquidity source analysis for Nettlewhisk purchase
tickets.text: Prepare a mortgage liquidity source analysis for Julian and Iris Nettlewhisk's Portland, Oregon townhouse purchase ($945,000 price, $25,000 earnest money already paid from Teacup Comet Bank). Compare the $172,000 cash at Teacup Comet Bank, short-term bond holdings, taxable brokerage sales at Velvet Acorn Custody (~$286,000), and Julian's vested Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares (~$118,000) to fund the remaining down payment while preserving the $80,000 post-closing reserve target.
tickets.evidence: Julian asked for a mortgage liquidity source analysis comparing bank cash, short-term bond holdings, taxable brokerage sales, and vested employer shares to fund the remaining down payment while preserving the stated reserve target; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-10-08.

tickets.title: Upload bank and brokerage statements to lender portal
tickets.text: Upload the most recent Teacup Comet Bank statement and Velvet Acorn Custody brokerage statement to the lender's portal for Julian and Iris Nettlewhisk's mortgage underwriting. Provide documentation tying the $25,000 earnest money withdrawal to the Teacup Comet Bank checking account as the source account.
tickets.evidence: the lender’s portal shows the most recent Teacup Comet Bank statement and Velvet Acorn Custody brokerage statement have not been uploaded, and the underwriter is asking for documentation tying the earnest money withdrawal to the source account; this remains needed by 2025-10-06.

tickets.title: Review cash-flow effect of rate-lock alternatives
tickets.text: Review the cash-flow effect of the rate-lock alternatives and financing contingency timeline sent by the mortgage contact for Julian and Iris Nettlewhisk's Portland townhouse purchase. Compare against the household's ~$9,600 monthly spending, current $3,950 rent, and preliminary $5,850 mortgage payment (including escrow) before Julian responds.
tickets.evidence: Julian wants the cash-flow effect of the lock alternatives reviewed before he responds; the agreed review is due 2025-10-10.

tickets.title: Resolve student loan payment discrepancy in mortgage file
tickets.text: Resolve the student loan payment discrepancy in Julian and Iris Nettlewhisk's mortgage file: the application lists Iris's student loan payment as $640 per month, while her current servicer statement shows a $410 income-driven payment. Confirm the correct figure so the debt-to-income calculation used for underwriting is accurate.

tickets.title: Reconcile stale Velvet Acorn Custody aggregation feed
tickets.text: Reconcile the stale Velvet Acorn Custody aggregation feed in the planning portal for Julian and Iris Nettlewhisk so the liquidity worksheet reflects the current cash and short-term bond positions available for closing on the Portland townhouse purchase.

tickets.title: Coordinate new-home insurance and liability coverage
tickets.text: Coordinate new-home insurance and liability coverage for Julian and Iris Nettlewhisk's Portland, Oregon townhouse purchase, replacing the current renters-only policy set. Confirm coverage levels, binding timing before closing, and any beneficiary updates alongside the existing $1,000,000 term life on Julian and $750,000 on Iris.
tickets.evidence: the agreed new-home insurance and liability coordination is due 2025-10-15.

tickets.title: Review tax lots in taxable ETF positions
tickets.text: Review the tax lots in Julian and Iris Nettlewhisk's taxable ETF positions at Velvet Acorn Custody to identify which holdings are most suitable if brokerage assets are used for closing cash on the Portland townhouse purchase. Flag positions with both short-term gain lots and lower-gain long-term lots that affect the suitability of each holding.
tickets.evidence: the agreed tax-lot review is due 2025-10-09.
